Sea Park Affordable Housing with Easy Access to Subways, Buses, and the Beach

Sea Park offers affordable living in the heart of Coney Island, Brooklyn, with select duplex and triplex residences and limited townhomes. Some units feature private balconies. Expanded living space in all units. Homes offer bright layouts, generous closets, and functional kitchens. Located near the beach and boardwalk, with access to the D, F, N, and Q trains at Coney Island Stillwell Avenue, plus B36, B68, B74, and B82 bus routes, connecting residents throughout Brooklyn and Manhattan.
